items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you play maybe Small's Paradise? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Charlie Johnson, that's right. Small's Paradise on 135th, I think it is, 135th and 7th.

ctx.x: Charlie Johnson, I can't recall the name. But I know that the Cotton Club was then on 147 in Lenox. Because we went down there for an audition when Duke was playing in there.
Did you play maybe Small's Paradise? Yeah, that's right.
Charlie Johnson, that's right. Small's Paradise on 135th, I think it is, 135th and 7th.
